tex_content.label: I.(10.2)
tex_content.html:
\begin{equation} (x',t')\in M_\alpha ,\quad t'\in (0,\bar t],\quad d_{t'}(x',x_0)\le d_{\bar t}(\bar x,x_0)+A|\Rm |^{-1/2}(\bar x,\bar t). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Iterate a violating point, multiplying curvature by $4$ each step. Then $|\Rm |(x_k,t_k)\ge 4^{k-1}\epsilon ^{-2}$ and

\begin{equation} d(x_k,t_k)\le \epsilon +2A|\Rm |^{-1/2}(x_1,t_1)\le (2A+1)\epsilon . \end{equation}

Smoothness forces termination.

□
